make.exploringNothingIsSizedFor: Just looking: nothing is sized for a meal. Pick a meal to see what your plan has for it.
make.snackOffThePlanNot: Snack: off the plan, not sized for a meal.

make.todayIsWhatYouEat.text: Today is what you eat now. A day before adds what you ate; a day after plans what you will eat.

travel.kitchenHint.hotel: Eating out and food you can buy and eat as it is. Chef Mealan suggests nothing to cook.
travel.kitchenHint.flat: Basic tools: stovetop, pan, pot. No oven, no scale.
travel.kitchenHint.family: A full kitchen; their shops. Chef Mealan cooks as at home.
goal.who.recomp: lose fat and build muscle at the same time
goal.who.maintain: your weight and your strength stay where they are
goal.who.gain: your weight goes up slowly, mostly as muscle
goal.who.performance: enough food for heavy training or endurance sport
goal.who.gainsteady: steady progress in strength; your weight goes up slowly
goal.point.recomp.1: Lose fat and build muscle at the same time.
goal.point.recomp.2: Your weight stays about the same; your shape changes.
goal.point.recomp.3: A little less food than you burn, about 10 % less.
goal.point.recomp.4: Works with regular strength training, at least twice a week.
goal.point.fatloss.1: Your weight goes down, about 0.5 to 1 % a week.
goal.point.fatloss.2: Less food than you burn, about 20 % less.
goal.point.fatloss.3: Protein at the top of your range, to keep your muscle.
goal.point.maintain.1: Your weight stays where it is.
goal.point.maintain.2: With training, you can still get stronger.
goal.point.maintain.3: As much food as you burn.
goal.point.gain.1: More food than you burn, mostly as carbs for training.
goal.point.gain.2: With training, most of the gain is muscle.
goal.point.performance.1: For heavy training or endurance sport.
goal.point.performance.2: Enough food to train well and recover, with more of it from carbs.
goal.point.gainsteady.1: More food than you burn, about 5 % more.
goal.point.gainsteady.2: Your lifts go up first; your weight follows slowly.
safetyq.detail.medication: anticoagulants, MAO inhibitors, thyroid, anything your doctor told you about with food
sheet.food.performance: about 5 % more, more of it carbs
sheet.progress.fatloss: weight and waist down, lifts holding
sheet.progress.recomp: waist down, lifts up, weight about the same
sheet.progress.gainsteady: heavier lifts, waist about the same
sheet.progress.gain: weight up at the pace, lifts up, waist rising slowly
